summary: Reran restored OfficeFlow smoke tests. Health/root APIs, login page controls, and unauthenticated dashboard redirect pass. Admin authentication remains blocked because login returns HTTP 500 when JWT_SECRET is absent.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500; backend traceback shows KeyError: JWT_SECRET in utils/auth.py while creating the access token.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot authenticate or load protected dashboard routes because the login API returns HTTP 500.

action_items: Provide JWT_SECRET in backend/.env/runtime configuration and restart backend, then retest login, /api/auth/me, cookies, and all protected dashboard routes.
critical_code_review_comments: Authentication requires os.environ['JWT_SECRET'] but the deployed environment does not define it; startup does not fail fast, allowing health to pass while login is broken.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; existing startup seed ensured admin@example.com exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login page and unauthenticated /dashboard redirect verified in browser. Health/root pass. Authenticated dashboard routes were not testable until JWT_SECRET is configured.
rca of the issue: POST /api/auth/login reaches routes/auth.py:125, calls create_access_token, then utils/auth.py:get_jwt_secret reads os.environ['JWT_SECRET']; missing configuration raises KeyError and becomes HTTP 500. Add the secret to backend runtime configuration (without hardcoding), restart, and rerun the auth/dashboard suite. STORAGE INITIALIZATION also logs a non-blocking 400 warning during startup.
